{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
num_internal_test_orders = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~internal_test_mask)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].sum()

# Print all required values
print(num_internal_test_orders)
print(total_revenue)

# Return total_revenue for submission
print(total_revenue)"}
